claim_one_line: THE NINE'S TARGET AND THE PRINCIPLED PENCILS (P-352; POST HOC exploration, labelled; NEGATIVE for its question): the web seat's one-Higgs optimum (one free direction read S in every sector, c = 3) reproduces on main exactly (chi2_nine 17.257, 18.279, 20.846, 21.518 on L_2, 26.92 on L_max) at a nearly null direction with a nearly constant invariant |h.h|/|h|^2 = 0.015-0.019 and an e1 admixture |delta| 0.2-0.33 (four free reals against seven independent numbers there: a target, not evidence); no pencil of two record forms with one complex number free (DR|R, which holds the weight pencil, DR|D2R, and the shared-multiplier pairs F22|F-2, F6|F-6, F14|F-10, each also conjugated) goes below chi2_nine 41.9 anywhere on the grid (the bar 21.67). The web seat's R5 verified: in the idealised up channel m1 = 0, m2 m3 = |a3|^2 |h.h| to 1e-15, m2/m3 >= |h.h|/4. A principle fixing |h.h| and the e1 admixture is the open route. 0 of 19.
